verification_notes: Context: the WebSearch budget was exhausted (200/200). Verification relied on fetching primary sources directly: the unenouvelleenergie.fr programme pages, its 62 campaign FAQ pages (updated 3 Oct 2026), and the Bayeux speech PDF of 17 Jun 2026.
Source caveat: the campaign FAQ pages are campaign paraphrases with dated quotes attributed to Lisnard. They are not independent outlets, and cross-lean corroboration could not be done.
monvote2027.fr is an aggregator whose 'quotes' are partly its own inferences, e.g. imm7 and sec3. simulateur-lisnard2027.fr describes itself as 'Site non officiel' and was not cited.
